project.name: Miyori Kitsune
project.runtime: Python 3.10+ stdlib local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1

user_intent.product: личная AI Miyori Kitsune, которая со временем учится, развивается, накапливает опыт, навыки, модель мира и историю
user_intent.ui_preference: не раздувать сайт техническими блоками; чат является главным интерфейсом управления и статусов
user_intent.cloudru: Cloud.ru — учитель Miyori и облачная вычислительная среда. Готовая сильная модель Cloud.ru не должна подменять личность Miyori: она используется для критики, разметки, объяснений, проверки, генерации качественных тренировочных примеров, оценки новых версий и GPU-обучения собственного Miyori Student. Ключи вводятся только в Личном кабинете.
user_intent.autonomy: развитие через proposal -> sandbox/test -> approval -> apply -> rollback; без бесконтрольного self_modify()
user_intent.paid_training: не запускать платные GPU job автоматически; запуск только отдельным контролируемым действием
user_intent.ai_identity: Miyori Kitsune должна оставаться собственной личной AI пользователя: собственная личность, память, модель мира, навыки, история развития и собственные версии модели/весов.
user_intent.teacher_student: Целевая архитектура: Miyori Student — основной развиваемый мозг Miyori; Cloud Teacher — внешний сильный учитель за кулисами. Teacher не должен постоянно отвечать пользователю вместо Miyori.
user_intent.model_ownership: Собственные версии Miyori Student могут храниться и исполняться в облаке; локальная модель не является обязательной.

current_brain_behavior.model_runtime: dynamic runtime selected from Model Registry; internal planner is safe fallback; llama_cpp local GGUF runtime supported when configured
current_brain_behavior.memory_retrieval: hybrid retrieval: lexical + importance + confidence + recency + vector similarity; real neural semantic weight is enabled when a local sentence-transformers model is configured

embodiment.vision: enabled via chat-image adapter; direct camera hardware not connected
embodiment.hearing: channel defined, disabled until audio/microphone adapter exists
embodiment.speech: channel defined, disabled until TTS adapter exists
embodiment.hands: enabled through Action Gateway for controlled digital actions
embodiment.mobility: channel defined, disabled until navigation/robotics adapter exists

current_brain_behavior.neural_safety: free conversation may use neural runtime; real actions remain planned/executed through deterministic planner and Action Gateway
current_brain_behavior.model_promotion: evaluation never auto-promotes; active model promotion still requires explicit approval
current_brain_behavior.teacher_student_target: Следующий архитектурный приоритет — реализовать Teacher–Student orchestration: Cloud Teacher участвует только в обучении/критике/оценке, а не подменяет Miyori Student в обычном диалоге.

teacher_student.student: Miyori Brain/Student remains the response-producing system. The current built-in planner remains fallback until a dedicated cloud-hosted Miyori Student model endpoint/weights exist.
teacher_student.teacher: Cloud Teacher uses Cloud.ru Foundation Models only for critique, labeling and teaching signals. It never replaces the already generated Miyori response.
teacher_student.auto_review: disabled by default because it causes paid API calls
teacher_student.manual_review: available from chat after a Miyori response
teacher_student.training_acceptance: teacher feedback is excluded from datasets until explicitly marked accepted_for_training by the user

cloudru.purpose: GPU training infrastructure for Miyori, not identity replacement
cloudru.secret_policy: never commit secrets; API returns only saved/configured flags, not secret values
cloudru.windows_storage: Windows DPAPI for Key Secret and x-api-key

foundation_models.auth: separate Foundation Models API Key stored locally/encrypted like other secrets

training.role: GPU training for Miyori Student candidates
training.credentials: existing Key ID / Key Secret / Workspace ID / x-api-key remain separate from Foundation Models key

sources: useful user->assistant pairs from Brain sessions

known_gaps: no real local authentication/session enforcement yet
updater still needs ZIP-slip validation, hashes/signatures, atomic install and rollback API
JSON storage will eventually need migration to SQLite as data grows
real neural embeddings require an explicitly configured local sentence-transformers model
real neural generation requires a local GGUF artifact plus llama-cpp-python; no trained Miyori weights exist yet
camera, microphone, TTS and physical mobility adapters are still not implemented

critical_repo_history.incident: commit 41ee... used malformed atomic tree operation and unintentionally removed files
critical_repo_history.rule: DO NOT use create_tree casually. Prefer per-file GitHub create/update operations and fetch latest SHA before every update.
critical_repo_history.recovery: files were restored individually; force reset was not used

Do not bloat UI with technical pages; prefer chat-based introspection and actions.

Preserve current architecture instead of rewriting from scratch.
latest_commits: Add Cloud Teacher safety regression tests
Add explicit Cloud Teacher review workflow in chat

teacher_student_architecture.principle: Cloud.ru teaches Miyori; Cloud.ru is not Miyori.

miyori_student.deployment: может храниться и работать в облаке; локальный запуск не обязателен

cloud_teacher.role: внешний сильный учитель и вычислительная инфраструктура
cloud_teacher.forbidden_product_role: не должен становиться постоянным основным ответчиком вместо Miyori Student

learning_loop: Cloud Teacher при необходимости критикует, исправляет и размечает опыт
подтверждённые данные попадают в training dataset

target_flow.online: User -> Miyori context/memory/world model -> Miyori Student -> response
target_flow.learning: Miyori experience -> Cloud Teacher -> critique/labels -> dataset -> GPU training -> new Miyori Student candidate -> evaluation -> approval -> promote/rollback
